label: oie
subtype: Animaux domestiques et de la ferme
prompt: Paint one anatomically correct animal, whole body and all visible feet within a generously spaced standalone 4:3 landscape PNG. Matte hand-painted TCF classroom style from supplied references, gentle soft lighting, precise edges, warm natural volumes. Flat opaque untextured uniform ivory #FDF2E1 RGB 253 242 225, especially the four 30px corners, no backdrop or vignette. Tiny soft contact shadow under feet. No landscape, food or extras, no other animal, no marks, text or border. A white adult domestic goose as typically seen on a farm (Embden), with long but not swan-curved upright neck, low stocky oval body, short stout orange wedge-shaped bill with no black bill bulge, low forehead and two clearly separate large webbed orange feet. Slight grey wing shadows. Quiet side view with head facing right.
review_note: Le long cou presque droit, le bec orange sans renflement sombre et les pattes palmées orange identifient une oie domestique.
